description: Local ffmpeg HLS demo: broadcasts the flute-ffmpeg example's own test loop (llama_drama, 2 renditions) over MBMS via a real xMB Application/Pull session. The source is plain HTTP on localhost (python http.server serving flute-ffmpeg/watchfolder/hls), so no TLS proxy is needed -- unlike rtve-24h.json's CDN source. Load, then Activate the session in the portal's xMB tab.
